sources.snippet: DiTree project page , paper Official implementation of the paper "Train Once Plan Anywhere Kinodynamic Motion Planning via Diffusion Trees" [CoRL 25] This repository contains the code and experiment setup for Train-Once Plan-Anywhere Kinodynamic Motion Planning via Diffusion Trees .

sources.title: Train-Once Plan-Anywhere Kinodynamic Motion Planning via Diffusion Trees
sources.snippet: DiTree combines DP's ability to model complex distributions of expert trajectories, conditioned on local observations, with the completeness of SBPs to yield provably-safe solutions within a few action propagation iterations for complex dynamical systems.
